sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and have won seven of their last five matches overall, so a fixture against bottom-placed Alsager Town (just 4 points from 10 games) presents a strong opportunity to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second place with 20 points, face a crucial away trip to Dawley Town as they pursue the leaders. The title race tightens with AFC Bridgnorth (19 points, 8 games played) and Wolverhampton Casuals (19 points, 9 games) both in contention, with Bridgnorth hosting AFC Bridgnorth and Casuals hosting Wolverhampton Casuals respectively on Saturday. Eccleshall, also on 18 points, take on AFC Bridgnorth at home. In-form Bilston Town (5 wins in last 5) welcome Foley Meir, while Barnton host Shawbury United—both mid-table fixtures. Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills in a clash between sides struggling for consistency. Cheadle Heath Nomads, second-bottom, face Telford Town (bottom six) in a fixture between lower-table sides. Brereton Social host Widnes Town, with the visitors still seeking their first win of the season (0 wins, 2 draws, 5 losses). Crewe face Allscott Heath at home, with both sides looking to climb away from the lower reaches of the division.
